## Joining the network?

- [ ] One file: `registry/instances/<id>.json`, with `<id>` equal to the map's `network.id`
- [ ] The map is deployed and `npm run join-check -- <url>` passes (Publish, Link, Prove)
- [ ] The map keeps the portal, the Nexus link and the meta tag (NETWORK.md)
- [ ] It publishes our own organization's companies

## Framework change?

- [ ] `npm run validate && npm test && npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run nexus:build` (if `nexus/` or `federation/` changed)
- [ ] Docs updated
